title: CompSkill: Compiling Execution Experience for Skill Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.01115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on skill documents, yet most retrievers rank them by description alone and ignore what earlier executions revealed, even though a relevant skill can hurt execution. We present CompSkill, which indexes skills with learned 512-d keys and compiles matched same-task comparisons into skill offsets and capped key residuals (KeyOpt), so experience changes which document the executor receives, never its text. Under a logistic outcome model with unknown task difficulty, matched comparisons cancel that difficulty and only discordant ones carry information; on support executions, predictions improve with each discordant task. An experience hypergraph keeps each comparison with its executor and document versions, recalls missed skills and grounds a cited review. translated_title: CompSkill：编译执行经验以用于技能检索
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越依赖技能文档，然而大多数检索器仅根据描述对技能进行排序，忽视了先前执行所揭示的信息，即使一个相关的技能也可能损害执行效果。我们提出CompSkill，它使用学习到的512维密钥对技能进行索引，并将匹配的同任务比较编译为技能偏移量和有上限的密钥残差，因此经验只会改变执行器接收到的文档，而绝不会改变其文本内容。在具有未知任务难度的逻辑结果模型下，匹配的比较可以抵消该难度，只有结果不一致的比较才携带信息；在支持执行上，预测随着每个不一致任务而不断改善。经验超图将每次比较与其执行器和文档版本关联保存，能够召回遗漏的技能并为有引用的审查提供依据。紧凑的密钥在仅八分之一的维度下将SkillRet NDCG@10从64.0提升到70.9。使用单个文档时，CompSkill在332个ToolQA任务中完成了256个和260个（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: CompSkill通过将执行经验编译为技能偏移量和紧凑的密钥残差来改进LLM智能体的技能检索，使系统能够根据实际执行结果动态选择最合适的技能文档而不修改文档文本本身。
en_tdlr: CompSkill improves skill retrieval for LLM agents by compiling execution experience into skill offsets and compact key residuals, enabling dynamic selection of skill documents based on actual execution outcomes without ever modifying the documents' text.
